note: Rewritten from Ahmad 1965 (this passage is a verbatim reprint of the description by Roonwal & Sen-Sarma 1960); original in English; the OCR is clear, and the measurements, given in mm in the original, have not been converted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule deep straw to yellowish brown (dorsally), antennae slightly paler, labrum straw coloured; pronotum concolorous with the dorsal head, abdominal tergites paler; head and body sparsely hairy. Body length (without wings) 7.0 mm, with wings 13.0—13.5 mm. Head capsule almost square in dorsal view, sparsely hairy; length to the mandibular base (1.55 mm) slightly greater than the maximum width including the compound eyes (1.44 mm); slightly convex dorsally; frons sloping gently forwards, not depressed in the middle; Y suture not visible. One pair of compound eyes, on the sides of the head, very large, maximum diameter including the eye sclerite 0.70 mm, almost circular (flat on the side facing the antennae), black, close against the antennae and almost touching the proximal margin of the antennal socket. One pair of lateral ocelli, one on each side, oval, translucent, whitish, close against the compound eyes and touching the eye sclerite, maximum diameter 0.25 mm. Antennae 19—20-segmented, all hairy except segment 1, the hair covering denser towards the apex; segment 1 cylindrical, longest and largest; segment 2 less than half as long as segment 1; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 smallest; segments 5 to the penultimate gradually lengthening; apical segment shorter than the penultimate. Postclypeus almost square, darker than the frons, without a boundary with the frons, anterolateral margins with 2—3 pairs of hairs; anteclypeus trapezoidal, whitish, longer than the postclypeus, hairless. Labrum almost square, swollen in the middle of the sides, narrowing towards both ends; anterior margin slightly rounded (often appearing straight because of bending); apex and clypeal surface hairy; length slightly less than the maximum width. Mandibles of the typical Kalotermes type; left mandible with one apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth finger-shaped and longer than the marginal teeth, the two marginal teeth large, triangular and nearly equal; right mandible also with one apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth nearly equal to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth slightly shorter than the first, the molar plate only slightly shorter than the posterior edge of the second marginal tooth and wavy. Pronotum almost square, covered with rather short hairs of moderate density; slightly to much wider than the head; maximum pronotum width 1.70—1.90 mm, length 1.0—1.14 mm, much more than half its width; anterior margin concave, without a median notch; sides sloping slightly backwards; posterior margin straight, with a shallow median concavity.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Known only from the alate. The soldier has not been described. Snyder (1949) and Holmgren (1913) record it from Bangkok, Thailand, the type locality being Makassar (Ujung Pandang), Sulawesi, Indonesia; Ahmad (1965) himself did not collect the species in Thailand, where it is known only from historical records at Bangkok.
